verdict.rationale: Windmill serves a live OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at app.windmill.dev/api/openapi.json and keeps a versioned source-of-truth openapi.yaml in its official GitHub repo, with a vendor-hosted Scalar reference that renders the spec. The probe's 404s were on www.windmill.dev marketing paths, a different host, so they do not contradict the app-domain spec. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of downloading the app-domain spec, and the deployed copy can lag the source spec by some releases.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Windmill's cloud instance serves its OpenAPI 3.0.3 document live at /api/openapi.json (info title "Windmill API")
The source-of-truth spec lives in the official windmill-labs/windmill repository (backend/windmill-api/openapi.yaml), versioned with each release.
Windmill vendor-hosts a Scalar API Reference at app.windmill.dev/openapi.html rendering the live spec
